Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished 2D game enemy concept sheet for the Chinese movable-type battle game 活字战斗. Input image 1 is ONLY the painterly execution / flat-color / linework reference (approved 墨灵); do NOT copy its feline mask, halo, horns, armor, cape or red ribbons. The primary requirement is its FLAT hand-painted appearance: large quiet opaque pigment color shapes, fine varied ink outlines, at most one or two hard-edged shadow shapes per major form, very little internal rendering. Rich designed silhouettes, mature character drawing. NO metallic gradient modeling, universal bright rim edges, all-over patina, grit, grain, noisy texture, miniature beveled parts, airbrush, realistic 3D render, stock cute mascot or generic spiky red-eyed monster. Same unified palette of warm paper ivory, near-black ink teal, muted ochre, small restrained cinnabar accent; flat warm light-gray neutral backdrop with no paper texture. Four LARGE separate full-body enemies in a balanced 2x2 concept board, enough breathing room, all feet and tips visible, each occupying most of its quadrant; one decisive three-quarter battle idle pose each, generally facing left. No environment, no UI, no stat cards, no frames, no additional mini poses or inset details. Small readable Chinese serif name label beneath each character, exactly the supplied name, no other text. Crisp high-resolution drawing with stable anatomy and functional construction. Their different silhouettes must remain obvious when thumbnail-sized. Layout can balance character visual weight without forcing identical height.
TOP LEFT 纸壳兵: broad square folded thick ivory paper cuirass surrounding a comically small but solemn dark-ink body. One continuous slightly bowed chest panel and folded-over shoulder flaps, one shoulder lower. Tiny head under a simple folded paper cap, serious small eyes, thin short arms and legs, one rigid paper forearm partly extended. A guarded shy stance. Quiet unmarked paper panels, structural fold shadows only. TOP RIGHT 连针蜂: delicate hovering wasp with tiny dark teal head/thorax, extremely slender curved waist and a deliberately oversized ochre needle stinger hanging under its rear abdomen. Four narrow translucent wings with just a few ink veins, fine folded legs. Strong negative space around waist, wings and long needle. Elegantly dangerous, no yellow-black stripes, no metallic armored segments. BOTTOM LEFT 倾砚: living thick rounded-trapezoid inkstone standing crookedly on two little ink feet of unequal length. Concave black ink basin tilted toward viewer, thick muted stone-teal outer rim, just two narrow eyes on the upper edge, no mouth. One side noticeably heavier; trying unsuccessfully to balance. A continuous black ink pool, not a bowl monster with limbs everywhere. BOTTOM RIGHT 折页蛾: delicate paper moth whose two wings resemble slightly unequal rectangular open book pages, broad thin ivory surfaces, soft outer corners and one clearly folded dog-ear. Tiny slender body hidden in center seam, short antennae, two short bookmark tails of unequal length with a small dark red accent. Wide and light, not armored origami or a butterfly covered in text.

TOP LEFT 留白童: quiet slightly turned small child with tiny head, narrow shoulders and an oversized warm ivory smock expanding into a broad softly rounded trapezoid, small feet. Small low-set normal eyes and tiny mouth, reserved demeanor, NO mask, holes, symbols, red glowing eyes or decorative writing. TOP RIGHT 墨蚀蠹: low flattened long ink-borer insect, thick broad front tapering to two short flexible tail feelers. BOTTOM RIGHT 炉腹兽: rear-heavy pear-shaped short-legged furnace animal, arched smooth back and small head on long blunt snout emerging from front chest. Massive low hanging belly forms furnace chamber organically, one horizontal furnace mouth slit in lower belly, one short thick exhaust neck behind head. Four short supporting feet, a hint of quiet breathing. Matte dark teal body, small dark cinnabar furnace opening only, no full-body lava cracks, fire mane or bolted-on stove.
